description: Use this when someone asks a listed company's share price, how its stock did today, its day range, volume or market cap, or wants several companies' prices side by side. Give it one or more tickers (AAPL, NYSE:BAC, SHOP.TO) or company names. Returns each company's last price with currency, change and % change, day range, volume, market cap where shares outstanding are known, the exchange priced, and the date and time of the price (delayed at least 15 minutes, or the day's close), with the company's 6ix.com page.

items.description: Ticker (AAPL, NYSE:BAC, SHOP.TO), company name, or the 6ix company link returned by find_company

name: get_share_price

failed.description: Lookups that failed for a moment, even when tried again; ask again

askedListing.description: The listing asked for when 6ix priced a different one (6ix keeps one price per company)

asOf.description: Time of a delayed quote (ISO 8601, UTC); null for a closing price

basis.description: delayed: at least 15 minutes old, taken while the market was open; close: that day's closing price

currency.description: ISO code; GBX = pence, ZAC = cents, ILA = agorot

day.description: Trading day the price is from (YYYY-MM-DD)

stale.description: A closing price more than a week old: the latest 6ix has for this listing (a halt, a delisting or no recent trades)

status.description: no_licence: 6ix may not give out prices for this exchange; not_covered: no price on 6ix for this listing yet

sameCompany.description: Names asked for that are a company already in the answer

title: Share price
